Subject: ClearWave MAP seed & week1 checklist

Hi Samira / procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan seed and a focused Week 1 checklist to accelerate the pilot kickoff. The doc is a living GDoc (link below) — highlights inside:

- Week 0 prep: IP allowlist, KMS thumbprint, basic network matrix
- Week 1: test dataset ingestion, sample inference run, latency/cost baseline
- Success criteria: 10% request coverage at 50ms median latency for the sample workload
- Owners: ClearWave (data + validation), Redwood (runtime + config)

Please take a look and share any must-have items by EOD Friday so we can lock the agenda for the kickoff call. If it helps, I can slot a 30-min kickoff for next Tuesday (Apr 20) at 10:00am PT — let me know whether that works.

Link to seed doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDefGhIJk_clearwave_map_seed

Attachments (stubs): clearwave_map_seed_v1.gdoc, week1_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Chloe Martin

- Ops checklist: add a quick KV cache warmup step (saves a ton on cold-start latency)
- Data: call out anonymization step (ClearWave will own but include a validation sample)
- Security: request SOC2 evidence link + a POA for any extra controls (Markus can own follow-up)

If you want, I pasted a 2-line owner matrix under Week 1 and a short note about quantization profiles we recommend for the sample model. I also attached a one-sheet Week 1 checklist (week1_checklist.xlsx) you can send along.
